description: Use this when the user asks for Greca House's research on Greek property asking prices: the regional overview, Athens neighbourhood medians, budget windows, the method or the CSV downloads. A dated snapshot of Greca House's own listings' ASKING prices, not a whole-market transaction-price index. Do not use it for forecasts, predicted appreciation, next-year price growth, time-series trends or questions about the whole market's future prices. Do not add 'current market' figures from memory; other sources may be cited only if you actually retrieve them separately.
